title: 第15章 正义还等着我们去伸张呢第16章 暴风城的蛇蝎美人
slug: 艾泽拉斯从掷骰子开始成神
lines: 瓦里安想说些什么，嘴唇动了动，最终还是沉默了。
月光下，艾伦转向那具女仆的骸骨，轻声问完了剩下一些不紧要的问题。
女仆一一回答，声音越来越微弱，最后化作一声叹息，缓缓躺回了棺材。
艾伦拿起铁锹。
这一次，他亲手将土一铲一铲填了回去。
填完后，他站在原地，对着那块简陋的木牌，艾米丽·巴克，一个他素不相识却因他而被打扰安眠的可怜人，深深鞠了一躬。
“谢谢。”他轻声说，“安息吧。”
回到暴风城时，天边已经泛起鱼肚白。
一夜未眠的几人拖着疲惫的脚步，在猪和哨声旅馆门前停下。
瓦里安和肖尔站在对面，两拨人隔着清晨的薄雾对视了一瞬。
“那……就此别过。”瓦里安的声音有些干涩。
艾伦点点头，没有说话。
他们转身，各自走进不同的方向。
旅馆房间里，艾伦坐在床边，望着手里那枚金灿灿的钱币出神。
那是温雷给他的定金，一个金币。
温雷正在整理行囊，察觉到他的沉默，转过头来。
艾伦站起身，走到温雷面前。
“对不起。”他的声音很轻，“斯塔文可能不是你要追查的那个人。但是我一定要找到他。”
他将那枚金币递到温雷面前。
意思很明显，他没法继续帮温雷在暴风城打掩护了。
之前的订金，退还给他。
温雷低头看着那枚金币，又抬头看着艾伦。
然后，他笑了，用只有两人能听见的声音说：
“你可别搞错了。我才是雇主。”他的声音里带着一丝揶揄，“任务还没有完成。找到斯塔文，我才会给你剩下的尾款。”
艾伦惊讶地抬起头。
斯塔文犯下的罪行，直到魔兽世界经典旧世才得以真相大白，黑暗之门8年，一个混迹在暴风城的高等精灵，没有理由是为了这桩案子来的。
温雷把艾伦握着金币的手掌合紧，推了回去，艾伦感觉莫名暖暖的。
当然，他指的是掌心的金币。
斯黛拉抱着一大包工程学零件从门外进来，正好看见两个大男人贴在一起，这一幕让她的小脸上写满了狐疑。
但她还是蹦蹦跳跳地跑到艾伦面前，仰起头，湛蓝的大眼睛里满是认真：
“恩人！我也愿意一起！我一定会帮助你的！”
艾伦看着这一高一矮两个人，张了张嘴，想说些什么，最后只是点了点头。

Varian wanted to say something, his lips moved, but he eventually fell silent.
Under the moonlight, Allen turned to the skeleton of the maid and softly asked the remaining unimportant questions.
The maid answered one by one, her voice getting weaker and weaker, and finally it turned into a sigh, and she slowly lay back in the coffin.
Alan picked up the shovel.
This time, he shoveled the soil back with his own hands.
After filling it out, he stood there and bowed deeply to the simple wooden sign, Emily Barker, a poor person whom he had never met but whose sleep was disturbed because of him.
"Thank you," he said softly, "rest in peace."
------------------
When we returned to Stormwind City, the sky was already turning white.
After a sleepless night, several people dragged their tired footsteps and stopped in front of the Pig and Whistle Hotel.
Varian and Shore stood opposite each other, and the two groups looked at each other for a moment through the early morning mist.
"Then... let's say goodbye." Varian's voice was dry.
Allen nodded and said nothing.
They turned around and walked in different directions.
In the hotel room, Allen sat beside the bed, looking at the golden coin in his hand in trance.
That was the deposit given to him by Wen Lei, a gold coin.
Wen Lei was packing his bags. He noticed his silence and turned around.
Allen stood up and walked to Wen Lei.
"I'm sorry." His voice was very soft, "Staven may not be the person you want to track down. But I must find him."
He handed the gold coin to Wen Lei.
The meaning was obvious, he could no longer help Wen Lei cover in Stormwind City.
The previous deposit was returned to him.
Wen Lei looked down at the gold coin, then looked up at Allen.
Then, he smiled and said in a voice that only two people could hear:
"Don't make any mistake. I am the employer." There was a hint of teasing in his voice, "The task is not completed yet. Only after you find Stavin can I give you the remaining balance."
Alan looked up in surprise.
The truth about the crimes Stavin committed was not revealed until the classic world of World of Warcraft. In the 8th year of the Dark Portal, a high elf who was hiding in Stormwind City had no reason to come here for this case.
Wen Lei closed Allen's palm holding the gold coin tightly and pushed it back. Allen felt inexplicably warm.
Of course, he was referring to the gold coins in his palm.
Stella came in from the door holding a large bag of engineering parts, and happened to see two grown men sticking together. This scene made her little face full of suspicion.
But she still jumped up to Allen, raised her head, her big blue eyes were full of seriousness:
"Benefactor! I am willing to join you! I will definitely help you!"
Allen looked at the tall and short people, opened his mouth, wanted to say something, and finally just nodded.
title_en: Chapter 15 Justice is still waiting for us to be served Chapter 16 The Femme Fatale of Stormwind City
